courses.title: Applied Machine Learning: Foundations
courses.why: Matt Harrison's end-to-end workflow in Python: exploration, data processing, building, evaluating and tuning a model, then deployment with MLflow. The lifecycle the ML chapters teach, in one practical pass.

courses.title: Applied Machine Learning: Supervised Learning
courses.why: The follow-on course: classification and regression from linear models to XGBoost, plus evaluation, tuning and serving.

courses.title: Machine Learning with scikit-learn
courses.why: The newest and shortest: supervised and unsupervised learning in scikit-learn, including pipelines. Good as a fast refresher right before an interview.

portals.name: Kaggle Learn: Intro to Machine Learning
portals.what: A free, hands-on course of short lessons with exercise notebooks (validation, under- and overfitting, random forests).

portals.name: Google Machine Learning Crash Course
portals.what: Google's practical introduction: regression and classification, data preparation, overfitting, neural networks, embeddings and production ML.

portals.name: GeeksforGeeks: Machine learning interview questions
portals.what: A long list of ML interview questions with answers, from bias–variance to ensembles and evaluation metrics.

portals.name: DataLemur: interview questions (ML and statistics)
portals.what: Real interview questions from large tech companies; filter to Machine Learning, Statistics and Probability. Many free, some paid.

assessments.name: Kaggle Learn course certificates
assessments.format: Complete every lesson's exercise notebook; no proctored exam
assessments.credential: Kaggle certificate of completion, linked from your Kaggle profile
assessments.why: The quickest credential: a few hours each for Intro to ML and Intermediate ML. It shows hands-on practice, not certification-level depth.

assessments.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
assessments.cost: $75 (MLA-C02 beta, English); the English MLA-C01 ($150) closed on 28 September 2026
assessments.format: MLA-C02 beta: 85 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions in 170 minutes; Pearson VUE test centre or online proctored. MLA-C01 stays available only in Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese until MLA-C02 is generally available.
assessments.credential: AWS certification with a Credly badge
assessments.why: Validates building, deploying and operating ML workloads, which pairs well with your cloud and production background. The English MLA-C01 is available through September 28, 2026.

assessments.name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
assessments.format: 50–60 multiple-choice and multiple-select questions in 2 hours; online or onsite proctored (Pearson VUE)
assessments.why: The most prestigious of the three: architecting, serving, automating and monitoring ML on Google Cloud. Recently updated for the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; Google recommends 3+ years of industry experience.
